   LNK_PARTY_ROLE : assembled from 3 per-source link model(s) over 2 source view(s).
   Legs: HUB_PARTY_HK
   RECONCILIATION RISK, stated here because it is not recoverable
   after load (s9.8):
     This link is declared with ONE LEG, as the map declares it. A
     one-leg link hash key is md5(upper(coalesce(bk,''))) while the
     hub key on the same row is md5(upper(bk)). The emit predicate
     guarantees the operand is non-blank, so coalesce is IDENTITY
     there and the two hash keys are BYTE-EQUAL: LNK_PARTY_ROLE_HK == HUB_PARTY_HK.
     The ROLE TOKEN IS NOT IN THE LINK KEY AT ALL, so one party in
     three roles yields three rows carrying ONE link hash key and the
     roles are indistinguishable by key. This is the same
     identity-collapse class found in the map in round 1, now in this
     build's own output. Built AS DECLARED (s5.7): no role leg was
     invented. Settling it needs a role discriminator in the link key,
     which is a MAP change, not a build change.
